title: MxAgile Evidence Manifest
description: Canonical index mapping verification scenarios to their promoted evidence artifacts. Enables traceability from Requirement/acceptance clause through scenario to screenshot/DOM assertion/result. File location: planning/evidence/manifests/<wave-id>-evidence-manifest.yaml. Git tracked. See policies/evidence-contract.md.

manifest_id.description: Stable identifier for this manifest, e.g. MFT-W01.

wave_id.description: Wave this manifest covers, e.g. W01.

created_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this manifest was first created.

reconciliation_run.description: Whether this manifest was produced by a lazy (gap-only) or full reconciliation run.

entries.description: Evidence entries, one per verification scenario or sub-scenario.

evidence_artifact.description: A single promoted evidence artifact. The 'source' field distinguishes target (mockup-side) from actual (application-side) evidence. See policies/mockup-materialization.md — Target vs Actual Evidence Separation.

source.description: mockup=collected from the HTML mockup rendered in Playwright (expected/target). application=collected from the running Mendix application (actual). reference=external design reference (PDF, image, Figma export) — immutable input, not runtime-produced. unknown=legacy artifact without classification. See policies/evidence-contract.md § Reference vs. Runtime Evidence.

supersedes.description: Optional: artifact_id of the evidence this artifact supersedes. When present, the superseded artifact should be in _history/ or marked as historical. See policies/evidence-contract.md § Evidence Lifecycle Stages.

lifecycle_stage.description: promoted=current authoritative evidence. superseded=replaced by newer evidence for the same scenario. historical=retained for traceability only.

path.description: Git-tracked canonical path relative to project root. Under planning/evidence/screenshots/target/ (mockup) or planning/evidence/screenshots/actual/ (application). NOT under .concord/ (gitignored).

capture_id.description: ID of the capture group that produced this artifact. Screenshot and DOM/accessibility/YAML snapshots from the same browser capture use exactly the same ID.

provenance.description: Original temporary source path before promotion, for audit trail.

promoted_at.description: ISO date when promoted from temporary to canonical.

passed.description: Whether this evidence supports a PASS finding.

capture_group.description: One atomic browser capture. Target mockup and actual application captures use separate capture IDs but the identical comparison_identity.

capture_source.description: Which side of the parity comparison this capture represents. Mockup and application captures require distinct capture IDs.

snapshots.description: DOM/accessibility/YAML snapshots taken as part of this same capture operation.

cleanliness_state.description: Only clean captures can enter the canonical manifest. Contaminated captures remain temporary and are not promoted.

entry_id.description: Stable identifier for this evidence entry, e.g. EVD-SCN-CUSTOMER-ADMIN-POPULATED.

scenario_id.description: The SCN-... identifier from the verification scenario.

screen_id.description: PAGE-... identifier from the UI inventory.

target_mockup.description: Active acceptance target used for comparison. For legacy single-file targets: path to the target HTML. For SPA bundles: use mockup_name + target_revision instead.

mockup_name.description: Optional: name of the SPA mockup bundle used as verification reference. Absent for single-file legacy evidence entries.

target_revision.description: Optional: accepted revision ID of the bundle verified against. Enables precise revision-aware staleness for this evidence entry. Points to planning/target-mockups/<mockup-name>/_history/<target_revision>/revision.yaml.

bundle_hash.description: Optional: SHA-256 bundle hash of the target at time of verification. Hash-based identity for the exact bundle state this evidence was collected against.

comparison_identity.description: Immutable reference/app/model identity shared by every artifact and phase in this parity run.

parity_report_path.description: Path to the parity-verification YAML that details dimension results.

target_evidence.description: Evidence collected from the MOCKUP / active target (expected state). Establishes what the target UI is expected to look like/behave. Collected during mockup materialization. Evidence source is the mockup rendered in Playwright. See policies/mockup-materialization.md — Target vs Actual Evidence Separation.

actual_evidence.description: Evidence collected from the RUNNING APPLICATION (observed state). Establishes what the application actually produces for this scenario. Evidence source is the application running in Playwright. Compared against target_evidence to produce parity_result.

capture_groups.description: Capture-time bindings. Every promoted screenshot and its DOM/accessibility/YAML snapshots must be linked to one capture group; matching names or timestamps alone do not establish provenance.

artifacts.description: LEGACY: use target_evidence and actual_evidence for new entries. Canonical promoted evidence artifacts for this entry when the target/actual distinction is not yet classified.

path.description: Git-tracked canonical path to the artifact, relative to project root. Must be under planning/evidence/screenshots/ or equivalent. NOT under .concord/ (which is gitignored).

dimension.description: Which parity dimension this artifact supports.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this artifact shows.

provenance.description: Original temporary source path before promotion, for audit trail.

promoted_at.description: ISO date when this artifact was promoted from temporary to canonical.

passed.description: Whether this artifact evidence supports a PASS or FAIL finding.

note.description: Optional narrative about this evidence entry.
